entities.name: APN rate control
entities.description: Controls the maximum number of uplink user data messages including uplink exception data reporting sent by the UE in a time interval for the APN. The UE limits the rate at which it generates uplink user data messages to comply with the APN rate control policy.

entities.name: APN rate control parameters
entities.description: Parameters provided by the network to the UE for enforcing APN rate control, including parameters for exception data reporting.

entities.name: APN rate control status
entities.description: Current status of APN rate control stored by the UE during inter-system changes, including validity period information.

entities.name: UE support indication
entities.description: Indication provided by the UE to the network regarding support for APN rate control and additional APN rate control for exception data reporting.

entities.name: Exception data reporting
entities.description: Uplink exception reports that can be sent even if the limit for APN rate control has been reached, under specific conditions.

entities.name: Inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode
entities.description: Condition where UE stores current APN rate control status for each APN associated with PDN connections being transferred.

entities.name: Inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode
entities.description: Condition where UE uses stored APN rate control status if PDN connections were transferred and validity period hasn't expired.

entities.name: PDU session release
entities.description: Condition where all PDU sessions associated with an APN are released after inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode.

relations.description: APN rate control procedure uses APN rate control parameters provided by the network.
Network provides APN rate control parameters for exception data only if UE indicates support for additional APN rate control for exception data reporting.
Exception data reporting is allowed even if APN rate control limit is reached when specific conditions related to APN rate control parameters are met.
Inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode triggers storage of current APN rate control status.
Inter-system change from N1 to S1 mode requires use of stored APN rate control status if conditions are met.
Release of all PDU sessions associated with an APN triggers deletion of stored APN rate control status for that APN.
